name: pull-quote
description: Editorial typographic device for setting off a notable passage inside article prose. One CSS class, no markup dependencies beyond a <blockquote>.
css:
.pull-quote { font-family: var(--pds-font-display); font-size: 1.35em; font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--pds-text-secondary); border-left: 4px solid var(--pds-brand-accent); padding: 0.5em 1.2em; margin: 2em 0; text-wrap: pretty; }
.pull-quote strong { font-weight: 400; }
aria: No ARIA needed — a styled <blockquote> carries correct implicit semantics on its own.
